breadcrumb: Std 6 Social Science Term-III (English) — History Unit 4: South Indian Kingdoms — Boxed notes (தெரிந்து தெளிவோம் / Do you know)

questions.quote: By the early 7th century, the far south had come under the control of the Pallava kings of Kanchipuram. Much of the central and eastern Deccan was under the Chalukyas of Badami (Vatapi), who were then pushed away by the Rashtrakutas.

en.q: By the early 7th century, the far south was under the control of the ______ of Kanchipuram.
en.explanation: The Chalukyas of Badami controlled the Deccan and were later pushed away by the Rashtrakutas.

ta.q: ஏழாம் நூற்றாண்டின் தொடக்கத்தில் தென்னகம் காஞ்சிபுரத்தின் ______ கட்டுப்பாட்டில் இருந்தது.
ta.explanation: தக்காணம் பாதாமிச் சாளுக்கியரிடம் இருந்தது; பின்னர் ராஷ்டிரகூடர் அவர்களை விரட்டினர்.

questions.quote: The central part of the Pallava kingdom was Thondaimandalam, a large political region comprising northern parts of Tamil Nadu and the adjoining Andhra districts. Kanchipuram was well known to Chinese and Roman merchants.

en.q: The central part of the Pallava kingdom was ______.
en.explanation: It comprised northern parts of Tamil Nadu and adjoining Andhra districts.

ta.explanation: இது தமிழகத்தின் வடபகுதியும் அருகிலுள்ள ஆந்திர மாவட்டங்களும் அடங்கியது.

questions.quote: Mahendravarman I was a follower of Jainism in the early part of his rule. He embraced Saivism by the Saivite saint Appar (Tirunavukkarasar). He is known for introducing a new style to Dravidian architecture, which is referred to as 'Mahendra style'. Mahendravarman also wrote plays, including Mattavilasa Prahasana in Sanskrit.

en.q: Mahendravarman I embraced Saivism under the influence of the saint ______.
en.explanation: He was a Jain in the early part of his rule.

ta.q: முதலாம் மகேந்திரவர்மன் ______ அடியாரின் தாக்கத்தால் சைவ சமயத்தைத் தழுவினார்.

questions.quote: Narasimhavarman II (c. 695–722), also known as Rajasimha, was a great military strategist. He exchanged ambassadors with China. During his reign, the famous Kailasanatha temple at Kanchipuram was built.

en.q: The Kailasanatha temple at Kanchipuram, called Rajasimheswaram, was built in the reign of ______.
en.explanation: It is the best example of structural temples of the Rajasimha style.

ta.q: இராசசிம்மேசுவரம் எனப்படும் காஞ்சி கைலாசநாதர் கோவில் ______ ஆட்சியில் கட்டப்பட்டது.
ta.explanation: இது ராசசிம்ம பாணி கற்றளிகளின் சிறந்த எடுத்துக்காட்டு.

questions.quote: The Shore Temple and various other temples carved from granite monoliths and the Varaha cave (7th century) at Mamallapuram are illustrious examples of Pallava architecture. In 1984, Mamallapuram was added to the list of UNESCO World Heritage Sites.

en.q: Mamallapuram was added to the list of UNESCO World Heritage Sites in ______.
en.explanation: The Shore Temple and rock-cut monolithic rathas are famous there.

ta.q: மாமல்லபுரம் யுனெஸ்கோ உலகப் பாரம்பரியச் சின்னங்களின் பட்டியலில் சேர்க்கப்பட்ட ஆண்டு ______.
ta.explanation: கடற்கரைக் கோவிலும் ஒற்றைக்கல் ரதங்களும் அங்கு புகழ்பெற்றவை.

questions.quote: Pallava architecture can be classified as 1. Rock-Cut temples - Mahendravarma style; 2. Monolithic Rathas and Sculptural Mandapas - Mamallan style; 3. Structural Temples - Rajasimhan style and Nandivarman style. The five rathas (chariots), popularly called Panchapandavar rathas, each carved out of a single rock.

en.q: The Panchapandavar rathas at Mamallapuram belong to the ______ style.
en.explanation: Each ratha is carved out of a single rock, hence called monolithic.

ta.explanation: ஒவ்வொரு ரதமும் ஒரே பாறையில் செதுக்கப்பட்டதால் ஒற்றைக்கல் ரதங்கள் எனப்படுகின்றன.

questions.quote: The Pallavas supported Jainism, Buddhism and the Vedic faith. Some of the Pallava kings patronised the Azhwars and Nayanmars. Among the Saivites were Appar and Manikkavasakar. Among the Vaishnavites were Nammazhvar and Andal. Gatika (monastery or centre of learning) at Kanchi was popular during the Pallava times.

en.q: The Gatika, a popular centre of learning in Pallava times, was located at ______.
en.explanation: It attracted students from all parts of India and abroad.

ta.q: பல்லவர் காலத்தில் புகழ்பெற்ற கல்வி மையமான கடிகை ______ இல் இருந்தது.
ta.explanation: இங்கு இந்தியாவின் பல பகுதிகளிலிருந்தும் வெளிநாட்டிலிருந்தும் மாணவர்கள் வந்தனர்.

questions.quote: Dandin composed Dashakumara Charita. Bharavi, the great Sanskrit scholar, lived in the time of Simhavishnu. Bharavi wrote Kiratarjuniya. Perundevanar, who was patronized by Nandivarman II, translated the Mahabharata into Tamil as Bharathavenba.

en.q: Perundevanar, patronised by Nandivarman II, translated the Mahabharata into Tamil as ______.
en.explanation: Bharavi wrote Kiratarjuniya, an epic in verses.

ta.q: இரண்டாம் நந்திவர்மனால் ஆதரிக்கப்பட்ட பெருந்தேவனார் மகாபாரதத்தைத் தமிழில் ______ எனப் பாடினார்.

questions.quote: The Chalukyas of Vatapi: Pulakesin I took and fortified the hill fort of Vatapi around 543 AD(CE). Pulakesin II (c.610 to 642) emerged as the most powerful ruler of the dynasty. The Persian king Khusru II sent an embassy to the court of Pulakesin II.

en.q: The Persian king who sent an embassy to the court of Pulakesin II was ______.
en.explanation: The reception given to the Persian embassy is depicted in a painting at Ajanta.

ta.q: இரண்டாம் புலிகேசியின் அவைக்குத் தூதுக்குழு அனுப்பிய பாரசீக மன்னன் ______.
ta.explanation: தூதுக்குழுவுக்கு அளித்த வரவேற்பு அஜந்தா ஓவியத்தில் உள்ளது.

questions.quote: Pattadakal (UNESCO World Heritage Site) is a small village in Bagalkot district of Karnataka. It has ten temples. Four were built in northern style (Nagara), while the rest six are in the southern (Dravida) style. The Virupaksha temple is built on the model of Kanchi Kailasanatha temple. Sculptors brought from Kanchi were employed in its construction.

en.q: The Virupaksha temple at Pattadakal was built on the model of the ______ temple.
en.explanation: Sculptors brought from Kanchi were employed in its construction.

ta.q: பட்டடக்கல் விருபாக்ஷர் கோவில் ______ கோவிலின் மாதிரியில் கட்டப்பட்டது.
ta.explanation: காஞ்சியிலிருந்து சிற்பிகள் அழைத்து வரப்பட்டு அதைக் கட்டினர்.

questions.quote: Dantidurga was the founder of Rashtrakuta dynasty. Krishna I consolidated and extended the Rashtrakuta power. The Kailasanatha temple at Ellora was built by him. The greatest king of the Rashtrakuta dynasty was Amogavarsha. He built a new capital at Manyakheta (now Malkhed in Karnataka).

en.q: The Kailasanatha temple at Ellora was built by the Rashtrakuta king ______.
en.explanation: It is one of 30 temples carved out of the hill at Ellora.

ta.q: எல்லோரா கைலாசநாதர் கோவிலைக் கட்டிய ராஷ்டிரகூட மன்னர் ______.
ta.explanation: எல்லோராவில் மலையில் குடைந்த 30 கோவில்களுள் இதுவும் ஒன்று.

questions.quote: Krishna II suffered a defeat in the battle of Vallala at the hands of Cholas under Parantaka in c. 916. Krishna III (c. 939–967) was the last able ruler of Rashtrakuta dynasty. He defeated the Cholas in the battle of Takkolam and captured Thanjavur. He built Krishneshwara temple at Rameshwaram.

en.q: In the battle of Takkolam, the Rashtrakuta king Krishna III defeated the ______.
en.explanation: Takkolam is in present-day Ranipet district; Krishna III captured Thanjavur.

ta.q: தக்கோலம் போரில் ராஷ்டிரகூட மன்னன் மூன்றாம் கிருஷ்ணன் தோற்கடித்தவர்கள் ______.
ta.explanation: தக்கோலம் இன்றைய இராணிப்பேட்டை மாவட்டத்தில் உள்ளது; மூன்றாம் கிருஷ்ணன் தஞ்சாவூரைக் கைப்பற்றினான்.

questions.quote: Kavirajamarga composed by Amogavarsha was the first poetic work in Kannada language. The three gems of Kannada literature during the period were Pampa, Sri Ponna and Ranna. Adikavi Pampa was famous for his creative works Adipurana and Vikramarjunavijaya.

en.q: The first poetic work in the Kannada language was ______.
en.explanation: It was composed by the Rashtrakuta king Amogavarsha.

questions.quote: Kailasanatha Temple at Ellora was one of the 30 temples carved out of the hill at Ellora. It was built during the reign of Krishna I. The temple covers an area of over 60,000 sq. feet and vimanam rises to a height of 90 feet. It portrays typical Dravidian features.

en.q: The Kailasanatha temple at Ellora is located near ______ in Maharashtra.
en.explanation: It has resemblance to the shore temple at Mamallapuram.

ta.q: எல்லோரா கைலாசநாதர் கோவில் மகாராஷ்டிரத்தில் ______ அருகே உள்ளது.

questions.quote: Elephanta Island, originally known as Sripuri and called Gharapuri by the local people, is an island near Mumbai. The Portuguese named it as Elephanta, after seeing the huge image of an elephant. The Trimurthi (three-faced) Siva icon is an illustrative of the sculptural beauty in the Cave Temple of Elephanta.

en.q: Elephanta Island, near Mumbai, got its present name from the ______ after they saw a huge elephant image.
en.explanation: It was originally known as Sripuri and called Gharapuri by locals.

ta.q: மும்பை அருகேயுள்ள எலிஃபெண்டா தீவு பெரிய யானைச் சிலையைக் கண்ட ______ இடப்பட்ட பெயரைக் கொண்டது.
ta.explanation: அதன் பழைய பெயர் ஸ்ரீபுரி; உள்ளூரார் காரபுரி என அழைத்தனர்.
